notes: These are root-level business contracts for the 49 frozen N8.16 roots. N8.17.C-G enrich data/API/UX/security/test detail and may add child MATRIX_ID entries after materiality review without weakening these root contracts.
global_invariants: Backend and persistence remain authoritative for business mutations; client state never grants authority by itself.
Authenticated internal flows are tenant-scoped and permission-scoped; cross-tenant access must fail closed.
A failed validation or authorization path must not leave a partial business mutation.
Retries must not silently duplicate the same logical mutation; concrete endpoint idempotency is refined in N8.17.D.

contracts.objective: Authenticate an eligible user and establish an application session without disclosing credential or account-state secrets.
preconditions: Submitted credentials are processed only by the authoritative authentication path
invariants: Authentication fails closed
Invalid credentials do not reveal whether a principal exists
Successful identity is the only source for subsequent authorization
happy_path: Backend validates identity and account eligibility
A valid authenticated session/token is established
User proceeds to an authorized application surface
alternate_flows: Invalid credentials return a generic denial
Inactive or unauthorized account is denied
Transient authentication failure leaves the user unauthenticated
side_effects: Authentication/session state may be created or refreshed
Security/audit telemetry may record the attempt without secrets
contracts.idempotency: Repeating a rejected attempt creates no business mutation; successful re-authentication may replace or refresh session state but must not create duplicate business records.

contracts.objective: Allow an authenticated user to view and maintain the profile attributes that policy permits them to change.
preconditions: Requested profile belongs to the active principal or an explicitly authorized administrative context
invariants: Identity ownership cannot be changed through profile presentation state
Protected security attributes require their dedicated authority
Tenant and principal boundaries remain enforced
happy_path: Backend validates and persists accepted changes
alternate_flows: Invalid field values are rejected without mutation
Concurrent or missing profile state returns a controlled error
contracts.idempotency: Submitting the same accepted profile values repeatedly converges to the same stored state.

contracts.objective: Administer the permission matrix that controls module/action authorization without granting privileges from client-only state.
preconditions: Administrator has the explicit permission-administration authority
invariants: Authorization decisions are enforced server-side
Permission changes remain tenant-scoped
A caller cannot self-escalate outside granted administrative authority
happy_path: Assignment is persisted and read back
alternate_flows: Conflicting or stale changes fail without partial privilege mutation
side_effects: Security audit trail records effective authorization changes
contracts.idempotency: Applying the same assignment state repeatedly yields one effective permission state, not duplicate grants.

contracts.objective: Manage tenant-scoped roles and their authorization composition as reusable access-control units.
invariants: Role identity and tenant ownership remain stable
Role edits cannot bypass permission authority
Referenced permissions must be valid
happy_path: Create or edit allowed role attributes and assignments
Persist and read back the role
alternate_flows: Duplicate or invalid role definitions are rejected
Deletion/deactivation with protected dependencies follows explicit policy rather than client assumption
side_effects: Role metadata and permission mappings may change
Effective authorization can change for assigned users
contracts.idempotency: Repeated application of the same role definition converges to one role state and one set of assignments.

contracts.objective: Administer application users, their lifecycle and allowed access associations within the active tenant.
invariants: Tenant ownership cannot be forged
Credential/security material is never treated as ordinary editable profile data
Privilege assignment remains separately authorized
happy_path: List or open a tenant user
Create or edit permitted account attributes
Persist and read back authoritative account state
alternate_flows: Invalid lifecycle transitions do not partially persist
side_effects: Authorization associations may be updated only through authorized paths
contracts.idempotency: Retrying the same desired user state must not create duplicate principals or duplicate role mappings.

contracts.objective: Maintain reusable product reference catalogs such as brands, models, colors and sizes used by product definitions.
invariants: Reference values remain tenant-scoped
Duplicate logical catalog values are prevented according to authoritative normalization
Referenced values are not silently removed while in protected use
happy_path: Create or edit a permitted value
alternate_flows: Duplicate or invalid values are rejected
Protected referenced values follow explicit deactivate/delete policy
side_effects: Products using those references may display the updated authoritative label/state
contracts.idempotency: Repeating the same desired reference value update converges to one catalog value.

contracts.objective: Manage product categories used to classify and navigate the tenant product catalog.
preconditions: Category permission for the requested action
invariants: Category identity remains tenant-scoped
Hierarchy/references cannot point to invalid or cross-tenant categories
Backend validates all mutations
happy_path: Create or edit an allowed category
Persist and read back category state
alternate_flows: Referenced category deletion follows protected dependency policy
side_effects: Dependent product presentation may reflect the updated category
contracts.idempotency: The same category update repeated produces one authoritative category state.

contracts.objective: Manage sellable product definitions and their catalog-facing attributes while preserving inventario and accounting boundaries.
preconditions: Product permission for the requested action
invariants: Product identity and tenant ownership are server-authoritative
Commercial/catalog attributes cannot directly forge inventario movements
Referenced category/catalog values must exist in the same tenant
happy_path: Persist and read back authoritative product
alternate_flows: Invalid references or duplicate business keys are rejected
Protected products follow explicit lifecycle policy rather than silent deletion
side_effects: Downstream sales/purchase presentation may observe the new product state
contracts.idempotency: Retrying the same desired product state must not create duplicate products or variants.

contracts.objective: Manage customer master data used by quotations, orders, invoices and receivables.
preconditions: Customer permission for the requested action
invariants: Customer identity is tenant-scoped
Sensitive/customer data follows authorized visibility
Referenced commercial documents keep stable customer linkage
happy_path: Backend validates business keys and fields
alternate_flows: Protected customers with dependencies are not silently destroyed
side_effects: Dependent commercial workflows may consume updated customer information
contracts.idempotency: Repeating the same customer mutation converges to one customer record and does not duplicate it.

contracts.objective: Administer shipping-cost rules used by billing/checkout calculations under server authority.
invariants: Shipping cost applied to a transaction is server-validated
Rules remain tenant-scoped
Client-provided totals cannot override authoritative calculation
alternate_flows: Overlapping/invalid rules are rejected according to backend constraints
Unavailable configuration produces controlled fallback/error behavior rather than client invention
contracts.idempotency: Applying the same shipping rule configuration repeatedly produces one effective rule set.

contracts.objective: Create and manage customer quotations that capture proposed commercial terms before order/invoice commitment.
invariants: Totals and commercial rules are revalidated server-side
Quotation ownership is tenant-scoped
Conversion to downstream documents must preserve traceability
happy_path: Persist quotation and expose authoritative result
alternate_flows: Stale or forbidden transitions fail without partial downstream creation
Expired/cancelled state follows explicit lifecycle rules
side_effects: Quotation and line state may be created/updated
Later conversion may create a traceable order/invoice through its own authoritative path
contracts.idempotency: A retry of the same logical quotation save/conversion must not create duplicate downstream documents.

contracts.objective: Manage discount definitions and eligibility rules used in commercial pricing.
invariants: Discount application is server-authoritative
Discounts remain within configured business bounds
Tenant isolation applies to definitions and use
happy_path: Backend validates rule scope and values
alternate_flows: Conflicting eligibility does not silently override authoritative precedence
contracts.idempotency: Repeating the same discount rule update converges to one rule state.

contracts.objective: Issue and manage customer invoices as authoritative billing documents with traceable totals, status and payments.
invariants: Totals, taxes and status transitions are server-calculated/validated
Issued documents retain tenant and audit traceability
Client state cannot fabricate payment or cancellation authority
happy_path: Backend validates and calculates authoritative amounts
Persist/issue according to lifecycle and return readback
alternate_flows: Cancellation/payment changes use explicit authorized paths
side_effects: Receivable/payment/accounting side effects may be triggered only by their authoritative business paths
contracts.idempotency: Retrying issue/payment-linked operations must not create duplicate invoices or duplicate financial effects for the same logical request.

contracts.objective: Manage sales orders from commercial commitment through fulfillment handoff while preserving inventario and billing traceability.
invariants: Order totals and lifecycle are backend-authoritative
Order lines remain tenant-scoped and traceable
Fulfillment/billing transitions cannot be forged by presentation state
happy_path: Persist order and expose authoritative lifecycle state
alternate_flows: Invalid stock/commercial references return controlled validation
Cancellation/fulfillment conflicts do not partially mutate
side_effects: Sales order and lines may change
Authorized downstream preparation/invoice flows may be enabled with traceability
contracts.idempotency: Retries of create/transition operations must not duplicate an order or repeat the same downstream transition.

contracts.objective: Manage customer-type classification used by commercial policies and reporting.
invariants: Types are tenant-scoped
Referenced types are not silently removed while protected
Business use relies on authoritative type identity rather than display label
alternate_flows: Deletion with dependencies follows explicit policy
side_effects: Dependent customer/report views may reflect updated type metadata
contracts.idempotency: Repeated submission of the same type definition produces one effective type.

contracts.objective: Provide the public/customer storefront journey for browsing products, cart, checkout and order status without exposing internal authority.
preconditions: Only published/eligible catalog data is exposed
invariants: Public client input never overrides authoritative price, stock, tax, shipping or payment rules
Internal-only data is not exposed
Order/customer access tokens or identifiers cannot cross authorization boundaries
happy_path: Backend revalidates all commercial values and creates/updates the permitted order flow
alternate_flows: Unavailable/invalid items are rejected or refreshed
Payment/checkout failure leaves no fabricated success
side_effects: Authorized checkout may create a customer/order/payment initiation through server-controlled paths
contracts.idempotency: Checkout retries reuse logical request identity where supported and must not duplicate the same order/payment intent.

contracts.objective: Record and manage sales transactions with authoritative commercial totals and traceable inventario/financial effects.
preconditions: Customer/product/payment references required by the transaction are valid
invariants: Totals/discounts/taxes are server-authoritative
Tenant and document ownership are enforced
Inventario/payment/accounting effects occur only once per accepted sale lifecycle
happy_path: Persist transaction and return authoritative status
side_effects: Inventario, receivable/payment or accounting effects may be triggered through authorized transactional boundaries
contracts.idempotency: Retrying the same logical sale operation must not duplicate the sale or its inventario/financial side effects.

contracts.objective: Manage purchase transactions from supplier sourcing/commitment to receipt/invoice-linked state with traceability.
invariants: Purchase totals and lifecycle are backend-authoritative
Supplier/document ownership is tenant-scoped
Receipt/inventario/payable effects cannot be duplicated
alternate_flows: Receipt/invoice discrepancies use explicit reconciliation paths
side_effects: Authorized receipt, inventario and payable flows may be enabled with traceability
contracts.idempotency: Retries must not duplicate a purchase document or repeat the same receipt/financial effect.

contracts.objective: Create and manage purchase orders as approved commitments to suppliers before reception/invoicing.
invariants: Order status and totals are backend-authoritative
Tenant ownership is enforced
Reception/invoice linkage preserves document traceability
alternate_flows: Cancellation/closure cannot erase already traceable downstream activity
side_effects: Purchase order and lines/status may change
Authorized downstream receptions/invoices may reference the order
contracts.idempotency: Repeated create/transition requests do not duplicate the purchase order or the same lifecycle event.

contracts.objective: Manage supplier master data used by purchasing, receiving and payable workflows.
invariants: Supplier identity is tenant-scoped
Sensitive/payment/contact fields follow permission policy
Referenced suppliers are not silently removed
alternate_flows: Protected dependent supplier follows explicit lifecycle policy
side_effects: Dependent purchasing documents may display updated supplier data
contracts.idempotency: Retrying the same supplier state does not create duplicate suppliers.

contracts.objective: Record purchase receptions against valid purchasing commitments and produce authoritative received-quantity/inventario effects.
invariants: Received quantities are server-validated
A reception is traceable to its source and tenant
Inventario effects occur once per accepted reception event
happy_path: Persist reception and resulting authoritative state
alternate_flows: Forbidden action fails without inventario mutation
side_effects: Inventario and purchase fulfillment state may change transactionally
contracts.idempotency: Retrying the same logical reception must not apply the same inventario increment twice.

contracts.objective: Capture and manage internal purchase requests before supplier commitment, preserving approval/traceability boundaries.
invariants: Request lifecycle is backend-authoritative
Approval/ordering authority cannot be inferred from UI state
Tenant ownership is enforced
alternate_flows: Converted/closed request cannot be silently reconverted
side_effects: Purchase request and lines/status may change
Authorized conversion may enable a traceable purchase order
contracts.idempotency: Repeated save/transition requests must not duplicate the request or repeat the same conversion.

contracts.objective: Manage warehouses as tenant-scoped inventario ownership/location anchors.
invariants: Warehouse identity is tenant-scoped
Referenced warehouses cannot be silently deleted
Inventario balances are not edited by warehouse master presentation state
alternate_flows: Warehouse with protected dependencies follows explicit lifecycle policy
side_effects: Location/inventario workflows may consume updated warehouse state
contracts.idempotency: Repeated desired warehouse state converges without duplicate warehouses.

contracts.objective: Present and control authoritative stock state and allowed inventario adjustments/movements across tenant locations.
invariants: Stock quantities are derived from authoritative movements/transactions
No client-only quantity override
Movement effects are tenant-scoped and applied once
happy_path: Initiate an allowed adjustment or movement
Persist transactional movement and refresh balances
side_effects: Inventario movement ledger and balances may change
Related order/purchase fulfillment state may observe resulting stock
contracts.idempotency: A retry of the same logical inventario movement must not apply quantity twice.

contracts.objective: Prepare sales-order items for fulfillment using authoritative order and inventario state.
invariants: Prepared quantities cannot exceed authorized remaining quantities/stock
Order and inventario tenant ownership must match
Preparation effects are traceable and non-duplicated
happy_path: Persist preparation and authoritative fulfillment state
alternate_flows: Stale or already completed order is rejected
side_effects: Inventario reservation/movement and order fulfillment state may change through authoritative transaction
contracts.idempotency: Retrying the same preparation event must not consume/prepare the same quantity twice.

contracts.objective: Manage tenant branches used to scope operational locations and business activity.
invariants: Branch identity is tenant-scoped
Referenced branches cannot be silently removed
Branch selection does not bypass authorization
alternate_flows: Branch with dependencies follows explicit lifecycle policy
side_effects: Operational location/report contexts may reflect the updated branch
contracts.idempotency: Repeated application of the same branch state yields one branch record.

contracts.objective: Manage warehouse sub-locations/bins used to locate inventario within a valid warehouse.
invariants: Location belongs to exactly the valid tenant/warehouse context
Referenced locations cannot be silently removed
Stock state is changed through movement authority, not master-data edits
alternate_flows: Location with stock/dependencies follows explicit lifecycle policy
contracts.idempotency: Repeating the same location definition converges without duplicate locations.

contracts.objective: Manage cash-register/session activity and cash movements with auditable balances and authorized lifecycle transitions.
invariants: Cash balance changes come from authoritative movements
Open/close lifecycle is backend-authoritative
A logical cash movement is applied once
happy_path: Persist movement/state and return authoritative balance
alternate_flows: Concurrent/stale lifecycle action returns controlled conflict
Forbidden action produces no cash effect
contracts.idempotency: Retries must not duplicate the same cash movement or lifecycle event.

contracts.objective: Manage tenant bank-account master/configuration data used by financial transactions without exposing protected credentials.
invariants: Account identity is tenant-scoped
Sensitive account/configuration data follows masking/permission rules
Transactions are not fabricated through master-data edits
happy_path: Persist and read back sanitized state
alternate_flows: Referenced account follows explicit lifecycle policy
side_effects: Future financial transaction selection may change
contracts.idempotency: Repeated desired account metadata converges without duplicate bank-account records.

contracts.objective: Manage supported payment methods and their eligibility/configuration for commercial and financial flows.
invariants: Method eligibility is server-authoritative
Sensitive provider/payment credentials are never stored as ordinary UI fields
Referenced methods are not silently removed
happy_path: Persist and expose sanitized authoritative state
alternate_flows: Provider/configuration failure does not expose secrets
side_effects: Commercial/payment flows may consume updated eligibility
contracts.idempotency: Repeating the same payment-method configuration yields one effective method state.

contracts.objective: Create and manage journal entries that preserve balanced, traceable accounting effects under authoritative period/account rules.
invariants: Debits and credits satisfy authoritative balance rules
Posted entries preserve tenant/audit trace
Closed-period or forbidden mutations fail closed
happy_path: Persist/post according to lifecycle and return readback
alternate_flows: Closed period or forbidden action is denied
side_effects: Financial balances/reports may reflect posted entry
contracts.idempotency: Retrying the same posting/reversal request must not create duplicate accounting effects.

contracts.objective: Manage cost-center classifications used to attribute financial activity and reporting.
invariants: Cost centers are tenant-scoped
Referenced cost centers are not silently removed
Financial postings rely on authoritative identity
alternate_flows: Referenced center follows explicit lifecycle policy
contracts.idempotency: Repeated desired cost-center state converges to one record.

contracts.objective: Track customer receivables, balances, due state and authorized settlement/reconciliation effects.
invariants: Outstanding balance is derived from authoritative documents/payments
Settlement cannot exceed/duplicate allowed effect
Tenant/customer ownership is enforced
side_effects: Financial reports may reflect the authoritative balance
contracts.idempotency: The same logical payment/allocation must not reduce the receivable more than once.

contracts.objective: Produce financial statements from authoritative accounting data and period context without client-side recomputation authority.
invariants: Statement values derive from authoritative accounting records
Tenant/period scope is enforced
Presentation filters cannot alter source postings
happy_path: User can inspect/export only permitted result
alternate_flows: Invalid/closed/unavailable context returns controlled error/empty state
Export preserves same authorized data scope
side_effects: Read/report generation only; optional export artifact may be produced without mutating accounting data
contracts.idempotency: Repeated reads for the same underlying state and parameters are read-idempotent.

contracts.objective: Provide authorized finance operations/overview that orchestrate financial state without bypassing source accounting/cash/bank authorities.
invariants: Displayed totals originate from authoritative sources
Mutations delegate to explicit financial business paths
Tenant scope is enforced
happy_path: Initiate only an authorized financial action
Backend validates and returns authoritative result
alternate_flows: Unavailable source data yields controlled state
Stale financial transition fails without partial effect
side_effects: Authorized delegated finance actions may create traceable financial effects
contracts.idempotency: Reads are idempotent; delegated mutation retries inherit the target operation's non-duplication contract.

contracts.objective: Manage tax definitions/rates/eligibility used by authoritative commercial and accounting calculations.
invariants: Applied tax is server-calculated/validated
Tax definitions are tenant-scoped
Historical document values are not silently rewritten by later configuration changes
happy_path: Persist and expose authoritative tax configuration
alternate_flows: Protected historical dependencies follow explicit lifecycle policy
side_effects: Future transaction tax calculation may change
Tax configuration audit state may change
contracts.idempotency: Repeated same tax definition update converges to one effective configuration.

contracts.objective: Manage accounting periods and their lifecycle so postings obey authoritative open/closed boundaries.
invariants: Period boundaries/lifecycle are backend-authoritative
Closed periods reject unauthorized postings
Overlapping/invalid period definitions are not accepted
happy_path: Create or transition permitted period state
alternate_flows: Period with blocking dependencies does not partially transition
contracts.idempotency: Repeating an already-applied valid period transition does not create a second lifecycle event/effect.

contracts.objective: Manage the chart of accounts used by accounting postings and reports with stable hierarchy and tenant ownership.
invariants: Account identity/hierarchy is tenant-scoped
Invalid cycles/parents are rejected
Accounts referenced by postings are not silently destroyed
alternate_flows: Referenced account follows explicit deactivate/reclassification policy
side_effects: Future postings/reporting classifications may use updated account state
contracts.idempotency: Repeated same account definition converges without duplicate accounts.

contracts.objective: Provide a governed entry point to available reports while preserving each report's permission and data scope.
preconditions: At least one relevant report permission
invariants: Report discovery does not grant data access
Each report enforces its own scope
Tenant isolation applies to all report data
alternate_flows: Unavailable data yields explicit empty/error state
side_effects: Read-only report navigation; exports may generate non-mutating artifacts
contracts.idempotency: Report discovery/read operations are idempotent for the same source state and parameters.

contracts.objective: Present authorized operational/business summary metrics derived from authoritative tenant data.
invariants: Metrics derive from authoritative sources
Tenant scope is enforced
Presentation aggregation cannot mutate source business data
alternate_flows: Unavailable metrics show explicit empty/error state
Partial source failure is not presented as fabricated complete data
contracts.idempotency: Repeated dashboard reads are idempotent for the same source state.

contracts.objective: Report profitability from authoritative sales/cost/accounting sources under permitted filters.
invariants: Profitability values are calculated from authoritative sources
Tenant/filter scope is enforced
Report does not mutate source transactions
alternate_flows: Missing data yields explicit empty/error state
contracts.idempotency: Same source state and parameters yield a repeatable read result.

contracts.objective: Provide administrative reports over authorized tenant operational/configuration data.
invariants: Only authorized fields/entities are exposed
Tenant isolation is enforced
Reports do not grant mutation authority
alternate_flows: No data shows explicit empty state
contracts.idempotency: Report reads are idempotent for the same source state and parameters.

contracts.objective: Report purchasing/supplier activity from authoritative purchase documents and related data.
invariants: Values derive from authoritative purchasing sources
Tenant and filter scope are enforced
Reporting does not alter purchasing lifecycle
contracts.idempotency: Repeated report reads are idempotent for unchanged source state.

contracts.objective: Report stock, movements and logistics state from authoritative inventario sources.
invariants: Reported quantities derive from authoritative inventario state
Tenant/warehouse scope is enforced
Reporting cannot mutate stock
happy_path: Backend validates scope and aggregates inventario data
contracts.idempotency: Repeated reads are idempotent for unchanged source state and filters.

contracts.objective: Report sales/commercial performance from authoritative sales/order/invoice sources.
invariants: Metrics derive from authoritative commercial records
Tenant/filter scope is enforced
Report presentation cannot modify transactions
happy_path: Backend validates and aggregates authorized sales data
contracts.idempotency: Repeated reads are idempotent for unchanged source state and parameters.

contracts.objective: Provide the application shell, navigation and guard boundary that routes users only toward surfaces they may attempt to access.
invariants: Client guards improve navigation but never replace backend authorization
Protected internal routes require authenticated/authorized context
Public routes expose only public contract data
happy_path: Backend independently authorizes any protected data/action
alternate_flows: Unknown route follows controlled not-found/fallback behavior
side_effects: Client navigation/session presentation state may change; shell itself must not create business mutations
contracts.idempotency: Repeated navigation to the same allowed route is presentation-idempotent.

contracts.objective: Allow authorized users to inspect audit history without altering historical evidence through the viewing surface.
invariants: Audit records are append-only/immutable from the viewer
Sensitive fields are masked/redacted according to policy
Tenant and permission scope are enforced
alternate_flows: No matching events shows explicit empty state
side_effects: Read-only; viewing does not mutate audited business state
contracts.idempotency: Repeated audit reads are idempotent for the same event set and filters.

contracts.objective: Ingest supported bulk data through validated, authorized and traceable import workflows without bypassing domain invariants.
invariants: Every imported mutation is revalidated by authoritative domain rules
Tenant scope cannot be supplied to escape current authority
Invalid rows do not silently become accepted records
happy_path: Accepted import applies through controlled transaction/batch semantics
alternate_flows: Row-level validation failures are reported explicitly
Forbidden import creates no target mutation
Retry behavior prevents silent duplicate imports
side_effects: Accepted rows may create/update target domain records
contracts.idempotency: A retried logical import must be identifiable and must not silently duplicate previously accepted rows.

contracts.objective: Manage tenant/application configuration that is safe to expose and edit through authorized runtime settings.
preconditions: Requested key is an allowed runtime setting
invariants: Secrets are not exposed as ordinary configuration values
Tenant-scoped settings cannot modify another tenant
Invalid configuration is rejected before it can destabilize business rules
happy_path: Persist and read back sanitized effective configuration
alternate_flows: Concurrent change returns authoritative latest state/conflict
side_effects: Dependent features may consume new effective configuration
contracts.idempotency: Applying the same configuration value repeatedly converges to one effective setting.
